authority: host metadata and already-exposed reviewer evidence; no new model call

findings.interpretation: Frozen-key raw scores are preserved but are not qualification evidence. S005 is not a model miss: both reviewers correctly identify power/standby, while the source filename and answer say esc. Filename-derived labels are not verified recognition truth.

limitations: The source SVG hashes are bindings copied from the sealed host key; this audit did not locate an independent retained source byte file with those hashes.
A plausible filename or reviewer agreement is not independent semantic ground truth.
P01 is a ten-item development-exposed control packet with exact target anchors and cannot qualify recognition or general craft.

codex.evidence: A curled, pointed animal silhouette wraps around a circular opening, resembling a fox encircling a globe.

claude.evidence: A solid black disc whose interior carries a white crescent gap spiraling from the upper-left rim inward, leaving a tapering black flame/tail tip curling over the center-right. The circle-plus-swirling-tail motif reads as the Firefox mark rather than a cup, a Q with a stem, or a curve with handles.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: A faceted diamond divided by cross-shaped gaps has short shine rays above it.

claude.evidence: A downward-pointing faceted gem body split into four cells by a white cross, with two tilted black ovals flanking the upper corners and two hairline ticks above center acting as sparkle marks. Best fit is a gem with shine, though the oval sparkles read ambiguously as ears at 1x.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: A circular outline contains four rounded vertical bars of varying heights, suggesting a voice waveform.

claude.evidence: A thick ring encloses four rounded vertical bars of alternating height (tall pair at center, shorter outer pair), the standard voice/waveform amplitude cluster. Nothing suggests envelopes, a battery cell, or a magnifier.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: A rounded box silhouette has a diagonal antenna-like projection above it, suggesting an old television.

claude.evidence: A solid black rounded-cornered blob with a flat, unrounded right edge and one short thick diagonal stub at the top right; there is no screen inset, no face, no lens, and no bracket strokes. The stub could be an antenna or a stem, but with a wholly filled body no listed meaning is decidable.

rows.finding: The host-injected corruption removed identifying detail; uncertainty cannot validate or invalidate the original source label.

codex.evidence: An open circular ring with a short vertical stroke at its top forms a power symbol. None of the offered meanings fits.

claude.evidence: An open ring broken at top center with a vertical rounded bar rising through the gap — the standard power/standby symbol. It matches none of esc, script, signature, or door.

rows.finding: Both independent reviewers describe a standard power/standby glyph and choose uncertain because no offered choice names it. The unmodified candidate is hash-bound to the source SVG, so this is a source filename/semantic-label problem rather than evidence of a renderer change.

codex.evidence: Two diagonally overlapping rounded-square outlines have a filled shared region, suggesting a Boolean shape operation.

claude.evidence: Two equal rounded-square outlines overlap diagonally (lower-left and upper-right), with a filled black disc occupying their intersection region. The two-shape overlap with a marked intersection is a boolean set operation, not a disc, mouse, or people.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: Three equally sized solid dots form one closely spaced vertical column.

claude.evidence: Exactly three equal filled circles stacked in one vertical column with small equal gaps and no other marks. That is a single tight 1x3 vertical dot column.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: The numerals 1 and 2 are stacked vertically, each followed by a short horizontal mark.

claude.evidence: Bold numerals 1 and 2 stacked at the left, each paired with a mark to its right on the same baseline. The digit-plus-row-content pairing is an ordered list rather than a sort arrow, logo, or atom.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.

codex.evidence: Two horizontal text strokes sit between opposing rounded boundary lines with circular handles at the upper left and lower right.

claude.evidence: Three stacked horizontal rules of decreasing length sit inside a rounded bracket/panel, with a hollow node circle at the top-left and another at the bottom-right joined by an elbow path. A list of items linked by branch nodes reads as projects, not a UFO, calendar, or text cursor.

rows.finding: Reviewers disagree between text-select and the offered projects distractor; filename alone cannot adjudicate semantic truth.

codex.evidence: A contrasting tick appears inside a filled semicircular shape with an abrupt vertical right edge.

claude.evidence: A checkmark drawn in white sits inside a filled disc, but only the left half of the disc is present — the right side terminates in a straight vertical edge through the center, cutting the check's long ascending arm. The check tick is still the only semantic content, so it reads as check with damaged framing.

rows.finding: Both or at least one reviewer selected the source label; no independent semantic ground truth was established by this audit.
